title: Deep learning in biology faces a transferability crisis
content:
by Thomas A. O’Shea-Wheller, Katie I. Murray

Creating generalizable models is a conserved aim in deep learning—however, misleading claims of transferability threaten to obfuscate reliable performance evaluation. We outline the severity of this issue in the biosciences, and suggest potential solutions.
